questions.text: Where are the Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
options: In the Indian Ocean near Africa
questions.explanation: The first sentence says they lie in the Bay of Bengal.
questions.passage: Far away in the Bay of Bengal lie the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, a Union Territory of India. There are hundreds of islands, big and small, but people live on only a few of them. Most of the land is covered with thick green forests. The sea around the islands is so clear that you can see colourful fish and coral reefs under the water. Tourists come to swim, to dive and to walk on the soft white beaches. The islands also have a sad history. During British rule, many freedom fighters were sent to the Cellular Jail here. They were kept alone in tiny cells, far from their families. People called this punishment 'Kala Pani'. Today the jail is a national memorial, and visitors bow their heads to honour the brave prisoners. To reach the islands, people travel by ship or by aeroplane from cities like Chennai and Kolkata.

questions.text: Where did Kabir find the puppy?
questions.explanation: He found it under a parked car.
questions.passage: One rainy evening, Kabir heard a weak cry from under a parked car. He bent down and found a small brown puppy, shivering and wet. Its front leg was hurt, and it could hardly stand. Kabir wrapped it in his school sweater and carried it home. His mother was worried at first, but when she saw the frightened little animal, her face softened. Together they dried the puppy, gave it some warm milk and made a bed for it in an old basket. The next morning, Kabir's father took it to an animal doctor, who put a bandage on its leg. In two weeks the puppy was running around the courtyard, wagging its tail. Kabir named it 'Lucky'. He also put a bowl of clean water outside the gate for the street dogs and birds. 'Animals cannot tell us when they are hungry or hurt,' he told his friends. 'So we must watch and help.'

questions.text: Neeraj is facing South. He turns left, and then turns left again. Which direction is he facing now?

questions.text: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 20 days?
questions.textHi: यदि आज बुधवार है, तो 20 दिन बाद कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: 20 = 14 + 6. After 14 days it is Wednesday again; 6 more days gives Tuesday.
questions.explanationHi: 20 = 14 + 6। 14 दिन बाद फिर बुधवार; 6 दिन और = मंगलवार।

questions.text: What is the angle between the two hands of a clock at 6 o'clock?
questions.textHi: 6 बजे घड़ी की दोनों सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?
questions.explanation: At 6:00 the hands point in opposite directions: 6 × 30° = 180°.

questions.text: 1 January 2025 was a Wednesday. What day of the week was 1 February 2025?
questions.textHi: 1 जनवरी 2025 को बुधवार था। 1 फ़रवरी 2025 को कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: January has 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. 3 days after Wednesday is Saturday.
questions.explanationHi: जनवरी में 31 दिन = 4 सप्ताह + 3 दिन। बुधवार के 3 दिन बाद शनिवार।

questions.text: If '×' means '+', '+' means '÷', '−' means '×' and '÷' means '−', find 8 × 6 + 2 − 3 ÷ 4.
Find the missing number: (12, 4, 3), (20, 5, 4), (36, 6, ?)
questions.explanation: The third number = first ÷ second: 36 ÷ 6 = 6.
questions.explanationHi: तीसरी संख्या = पहली ÷ दूसरी: 36 ÷ 6 = 6.

questions.text: Find the missing number: 2, 4, 12, 48, ?
questions.explanation: Multiply by 2, 3, 4, 5 in turn: 48 × 5 = 240.

questions.text: In a class of 40 children, 25 play cricket and 20 play football. Every child plays at least one of the two. How many play both?
questions.textHi: 40 बच्चों की कक्षा में 25 क्रिकेट और 20 फ़ुटबॉल खेलते हैं। हर बच्चा कम से कम एक खेल खेलता है। कितने बच्चे दोनों खेलते हैं?

questions.text: Which word looks exactly the same in a mirror held to its right?
questions.textHi: दाईं ओर रखे दर्पण में कौन-सा शब्द बिल्कुल वैसा ही दिखेगा?
questions.explanation: M and O look the same in a mirror and MOM reads the same both ways, so its mirror image is unchanged. D, B and P get reversed.
questions.explanationHi: M और O दर्पण में वैसे ही दिखते हैं और MOM दोनों ओर से एक-सा है। D, B, P उल्टे हो जाते हैं।

questions.explanation: In B, C and D the number of dots equals the number of sides (3, 4, 5). Figure A has 6 sides but only 5 dots.

questions.text: What is the difference between the place value and the face value of 6 in 3,62,451?
questions.textHi: 3,62,451 में 6 के स्थानीय मान और अंकित मान का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Place value = 60,000, face value = 6. Difference = 60,000 − 6 = 59,994.

questions.text: What is the smallest 6-digit number made using each of the digits 0, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9 once?
questions.textHi: अंक 0, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9 को एक-एक बार प्रयोग करके बनने वाली सबसे छोटी 6 अंकों की संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: A number cannot start with 0, so start with 3, then put 0 and the rest in increasing order: 3,05,789.
questions.explanationHi: संख्या 0 से शुरू नहीं हो सकती, इसलिए 3 पहले, फिर 0 और बाकी बढ़ते क्रम में: 3,05,789.

questions.text: The Roman numeral LXXVIII stands for
questions.textHi: रोमन संख्या LXXVIII का मान है
questions.explanation: L = 50, XX = 20, VIII = 8. Total 78.

questions.text: How is 2024 written in Roman numerals?
questions.textHi: 2024 को रोमन संख्या में कैसे लिखेंगे?
questions.explanation: 2000 = MM, 20 = XX, 4 = IV, so 2024 = MMXXIV.
questions.explanationHi: 2000 = MM, 20 = XX, 4 = IV, इसलिए 2024 = MMXXIV.

questions.text: Round off 47,365 to the nearest thousand.
questions.textHi: 47,365 को निकटतम हज़ार में पूर्णांकित कीजिए।
questions.explanation: The hundreds digit is 3 (less than 5), so it rounds down to 47,000.
questions.explanationHi: सैकड़े का अंक 3 है (5 से कम), इसलिए 47,000.

questions.text: What is the LCM of 15 and 20?
questions.textHi: 15 और 20 का LCM क्या है?

questions.text: What is the HCF of 45 and 75?
questions.textHi: 45 और 75 का HCF क्या है?

questions.text: Which is the smallest prime number?
questions.textHi: सबसे छोटी अभाज्य संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: 2 is the smallest prime (and the only even prime). 1 is not a prime number.
questions.explanationHi: 2 सबसे छोटी अभाज्य संख्या है। 1 अभाज्य नहीं है।

questions.text: How many factors does 36 have?
questions.textHi: 36 के कितने गुणनखंड हैं?
questions.explanation: Factors of 36: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36. That is 9 factors.

questions.text: What is 3/5 of 250?
0.4 written as a fraction in lowest terms is

questions.explanation: 25 × 4 = 100; there are 3 decimal places in all, so 0.100 = 0.1.
questions.explanationHi: 25 × 4 = 100; कुल 3 दशमलव स्थान, इसलिए 0.1.

questions.textHi: ₹800 में खरीदी गई घड़ी ₹720 में बेची गई। हानि प्रतिशत कितना है?

questions.text: Find the simple interest on ₹1,200 at 6% per annum for 2 years.
questions.textHi: ₹1,200 पर 6% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.text: In a class, the ratio of boys to girls is 4 : 5. If there are 45 girls, how many boys are there?
questions.textHi: एक कक्षा में लड़कों और लड़कियों का अनुपात 4 : 5 है। यदि 45 लड़कियाँ हैं, तो लड़के कितने हैं?
questions.explanation: 5 parts = 45, so 1 part = 9. Boys = 4 × 9 = 36.

questions.text: 6 kg of rice costs ₹270. What will 10 kg cost?
questions.textHi: 6 kg चावल ₹270 का है। 10 kg का मूल्य क्या होगा?

questions.text: 12 workers can finish a job in 15 days. How many days will 9 workers take?
questions.textHi: 12 मज़दूर एक काम 15 दिन में पूरा करते हैं। 9 मज़दूर कितने दिन लेंगे?
questions.explanation: Total work = 12 × 15 = 180 worker-days. 180 ÷ 9 = 20 days.

questions.text: A car moves at 60 km/h. How far will it go in 2½ hours?
questions.textHi: एक कार 60 km/h की चाल से चलती है। 2½ घंटे में वह कितनी दूरी तय करेगी?
questions.explanation: Distance = 60 × 2.5 = 150 km.

questions.text: How long will a bus take to cover 240 km at 48 km/h?
questions.textHi: 48 km/h की चाल से एक बस 240 km कितने समय में तय करेगी?
questions.explanation: Time = 240 ÷ 48 = 5 hours.

questions.text: What is the average of the first five odd numbers?
questions.textHi: पहली पाँच विषम संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?

questions.text: The average age of 4 boys is 12 years. A fifth boy aged 17 years joins them. What is the new average age?
questions.textHi: 4 लड़कों की औसत आयु 12 वर्ष है। 17 वर्ष का एक पाँचवाँ लड़का जुड़ता है। नई औसत आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total = 4 × 12 + 17 = 65. New average = 65 ÷ 5 = 13 years.

questions.text: 50 °F is equal to how many degrees Celsius? (F = 9C/5 + 32)
questions.textHi: 50 °F कितने डिग्री सेल्सियस के बराबर है? (F = 9C/5 + 32)

questions.text: 5 L 250 mL = ? mL
questions.textHi: 5 L 250 mL = कितने mL?
450 cm = कितने m?
questions.explanationHi: 100 cm = 1 m, इसलिए 450 cm = 4.5 m.

questions.text: What is the perimeter of a rectangle 18 cm long and 12 cm wide?
questions.textHi: 18 cm लंबे और 12 cm चौड़े आयत का परिमाप क्या है?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 × (18 + 12) = 60 cm.

questions.text: The perimeter of a square is 48 cm. What is its area?
questions.textHi: एक वर्ग का परिमाप 48 cm है। उसका क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanationHi: भुजा = 48 ÷ 4 = 12 cm। क्षेत्रफल = 144 cm².

questions.text: A rectangular park is 40 m long and 25 m wide. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹15 per metre?
questions.textHi: एक आयताकार पार्क 40 m लंबा और 25 m चौड़ा है। ₹15 प्रति मीटर की दर से उसकी बाड़ लगाने का खर्च क्या होगा?

questions.text: How many square tiles of side 50 cm are needed to cover a floor 6 m long and 4 m wide?
questions.textHi: 6 m लंबे और 4 m चौड़े फ़र्श को ढकने के लिए 50 cm भुजा वाली कितनी वर्गाकार टाइलें चाहिए?
questions.explanation: Along the length 6 m ÷ 0.5 m = 12 tiles, along the width 4 ÷ 0.5 = 8 tiles. 12 × 8 = 96.

questions.text: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 7 cm?
questions.textHi: 10 cm आधार और 7 cm ऊँचाई वाले त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 10 × 7 = 35 cm².
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल = ½ × आधार × ऊँचाई = ½ × 10 × 7 = 35 cm².

questions.text: What is the volume of a cube of side 5 cm?
questions.textHi: 5 cm भुजा वाले घन का आयतन क्या है?
questions.explanation: Volume = side × side × side = 5 × 5 × 5 = 125 cm³.

questions.text: What is the volume of a cuboid 8 cm long, 5 cm wide and 3 cm high?
questions.textHi: 8 cm लंबे, 5 cm चौड़े और 3 cm ऊँचे घनाभ का आयतन क्या है?
questions.explanation: Volume = l × b × h = 8 × 5 × 3 = 120 cm³.

questions.text: How many cubes of side 2 cm can be packed in a box 10 cm long, 6 cm wide and 4 cm high?
questions.textHi: 10 cm लंबे, 6 cm चौड़े और 4 cm ऊँचे डिब्बे में 2 cm भुजा वाले कितने घन रखे जा सकते हैं?

questions.text: A water tank is 2 m long, 1.5 m wide and 1 m deep. How many litres of water can it hold? (1 m³ = 1000 L)
questions.textHi: एक पानी की टंकी 2 m लंबी, 1.5 m चौड़ी और 1 m गहरी है। इसमें कितने लीटर पानी आएगा? (1 m³ = 1000 L)

questions.text: If the side of a square is doubled, its area becomes
questions.textHi: यदि किसी वर्ग की भुजा दोगुनी कर दी जाए, तो उसका क्षेत्रफल हो जाता है
questions.explanation: Area = side × side. With side 2a, area = 4a², which is 4 times a².
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल = भुजा × भुजा। भुजा 2a होने पर 4a², यानी 4 गुना।

questions.text: What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle of side 13 cm?
questions.textHi: 13 cm भुजा वाले समबाहु त्रिभुज का परिमाप क्या है?
questions.explanation: All three sides are equal: 3 × 13 = 39 cm.
questions.explanationHi: तीनों भुजाएँ बराबर: 3 × 13 = 39 cm.

questions.text: The area of a rectangle is 96 cm² and its length is 12 cm. What is its breadth?
questions.textHi: एक आयत का क्षेत्रफल 96 cm² और लंबाई 12 cm है। उसकी चौड़ाई क्या है?
questions.explanation: Breadth = area ÷ length = 96 ÷ 12 = 8 cm.

questions.text: The radius of a circle is 7 cm. What is its diameter?
questions.textHi: एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या 7 cm है। उसका व्यास क्या है?
questions.explanation: Diameter = 2 × radius = 14 cm.
questions.explanationHi: व्यास = 2 × त्रिज्या = 14 cm.

questions.text: What is the complement of an angle of 35°?
questions.textHi: 35° के कोण का पूरक कोण क्या है?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add up to 90°: 90 − 35 = 55°.

questions.text: How many right angles make a straight angle?
questions.textHi: कितने समकोण मिलकर एक ऋजु कोण बनाते हैं?
questions.explanation: A straight angle is 180° = 2 × 90°.

questions.text: 2 hours 45 minutes = ? minutes
questions.textHi: 2 घंटे 45 मिनट = कितने मिनट?

questions.text: In a pictograph, one ★ stands for 5 books. The row for Class 5 shows ★★★★★★★. How many books does Class 5 have?
questions.textHi: एक चित्रालेख में एक ★ = 5 किताबें। कक्षा 5 की पंक्ति में ★★★★★★★ हैं। कक्षा 5 के पास कितनी किताबें हैं?
questions.explanation: There are 7 stars, so 7 × 5 = 35 books.

questions.text: India's oldest national park, the Jim Corbett National Park, is in which state?
questions.textHi: भारत का सबसे पुराना राष्ट्रीय उद्यान, जिम कॉर्बेट राष्ट्रीय उद्यान, किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Jim Corbett National Park, set up in 1936, is in Uttarakhand.
questions.explanationHi: 1936 में बना जिम कॉर्बेट राष्ट्रीय उद्यान उत्तराखंड में है।

questions.text: Kaziranga National Park in Assam is famous for which animal?
questions.textHi: असम का काज़ीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस जीव के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Kaziranga is home to the largest number of one-horned rhinoceroses.
questions.explanationHi: काज़ीरंगा में सबसे अधिक एक सींग वाले गैंडे हैं।

questions.text: The Gir National Park, the only home of the Asiatic lion in the wild, is in which state?
questions.textHi: जंगल में एशियाई शेरों का एकमात्र घर, गिर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान, किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Gir National Park is in Gujarat.
questions.explanationHi: गिर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान गुजरात में है।

questions.text: The Sundarbans, famous for mangrove forests and the Royal Bengal tiger, are in which state?
questions.textHi: मैंग्रोव वनों और रॉयल बंगाल टाइगर के लिए प्रसिद्ध सुंदरबन किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: The Indian Sundarbans are in West Bengal, at the mouth of the Ganga and Brahmaputra.
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय सुंदरबन पश्चिम बंगाल में गंगा-ब्रह्मपुत्र के मुहाने पर हैं।

questions.text: Keoladeo National Park, famous for birds, is at Bharatpur in which state?
questions.textHi: पक्षियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध केवलादेव राष्ट्रीय उद्यान भरतपुर किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Keoladeo (Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary) is in Rajasthan.
questions.explanationHi: केवलादेव (भरतपुर पक्षी विहार) राजस्थान में है।

questions.text: The Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary (tiger reserve) is in which state?
questions.textHi: पेरियार वन्यजीव अभयारण्य (बाघ अभयारण्य) किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Periyar is in the hills of Kerala, around the Periyar lake.
questions.explanationHi: पेरियार केरल की पहाड़ियों में पेरियार झील के आसपास है।

questions.text: Bandipur National Park is located in which state?
questions.textHi: बांदीपुर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Bandipur National Park is in Karnataka.
questions.explanationHi: बांदीपुर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान कर्नाटक में है।

questions.text: Hemis National Park in Ladakh is best known for which animal?
questions.textHi: लद्दाख का हेमिस राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस जीव के लिए सबसे प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Hemis is famous for the snow leopard of the cold mountains.
questions.explanationHi: हेमिस ठंडे पहाड़ों के हिम तेंदुए के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

questions.text: In which year was Project Tiger started in India?
questions.textHi: भारत में प्रोजेक्ट टाइगर किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
questions.explanation: Project Tiger was launched in 1973 to save tigers.
questions.explanationHi: बाघों को बचाने के लिए प्रोजेक्ट टाइगर 1973 में शुरू हुआ।

questions.text: Ranthambore National Park, famous for tigers, is in which state?
questions.textHi: बाघों के लिए प्रसिद्ध रणथंभौर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Ranthambore is in the Sawai Madhopur district of Rajasthan.
questions.explanationHi: रणथंभौर राजस्थान के सवाई माधोपुर ज़िले में है।

questions.text: Who is known as the 'Missile Man of India'?
questions.textHi: 'भारत के मिसाइल मैन' के नाम से कौन जाने जाते हैं?
options: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

questions.explanation: Dr. Kalam led the work on India's missiles and later became President of India.

questions.text: Who is called the 'Nightingale of India'?
questions.textHi: 'भारत कोकिला' किसे कहा जाता है?

questions.text: Who is known as the 'Iron Man of India'?
questions.textHi: 'भारत के लौह पुरुष' कौन हैं?

questions.explanationHi: सरदार पटेल ने रियासतों को भारत में मिलाया; उन्हें लौह पुरुष कहते हैं।

questions.text: Who was the first woman of Indian origin to go into space?
questions.textHi: अंतरिक्ष में जाने वाली भारतीय मूल की पहली महिला कौन थीं?

questions.textHi: 1984 में अंतरिक्ष की यात्रा करने वाले पहले भारतीय नागरिक कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Squadron Leader Rakesh Sharma of the Indian Air Force went to space in 1984.
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय वायु सेना के स्क्वाड्रन लीडर राकेश शर्मा 1984 में अंतरिक्ष गए।

questions.text: Who served the poor and sick in Kolkata and received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979?
questions.textHi: कोलकाता में ग़रीबों और बीमारों की सेवा करने वाली किस महान हस्ती को 1979 में नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार मिला?
questions.explanation: Mother Teresa received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979.
questions.explanationHi: मदर टेरेसा को 1979 में नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार मिला।

questions.text: Who is known as the father of the Indian space programme?
questions.textHi: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष कार्यक्रम का जनक किसे कहा जाता है?

questions.text: Which Indian scientist won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930 for his work on the scattering of light?
questions.textHi: प्रकाश के प्रकीर्णन पर कार्य के लिए 1930 में भौतिकी का नोबेल पुरस्कार किस भारतीय वैज्ञानिक को मिला?
questions.explanation: Sir C. V. Raman won the 1930 Nobel Prize for the Raman Effect.

questions.text: Which athlete was known as the 'Flying Sikh'?
questions.textHi: किस धावक को 'फ़्लाइंग सिख' कहा जाता था?

questions.text: Who gave the famous call 'Give me blood, and I will give you freedom'?
questions.textHi: 'तुम मुझे ख़ून दो, मैं तुम्हें आज़ादी दूँगा' का नारा किसने दिया?

questions.explanationHi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय वन दिवस 21 मार्च को है।

questions.textHi: भोपाल गैस त्रासदी के पीड़ितों की याद में राष्ट्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?

questions.textHi: आकाश में गैस की कौन-सी परत हमें सूर्य की हानिकारक पराबैंगनी किरणों से बचाती है?
questions.explanation: The ozone layer absorbs most of the harmful UV rays.
questions.explanationHi: ओज़ोन परत अधिकांश हानिकारक पराबैंगनी किरणों को सोख लेती है।

questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रगान 'जन गण मन' किसने लिखा?
